# XPG MARS 980 BLADE PCIe Gen5 x4 M.2 2280 SSD

XPG MARS 980 BLADE PCIe Gen5 x4 M.2 2280 SSD

# MARS 980 BLADE PCIe Gen5 x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive

## MARS 980 BLADE PCIe Gen5 x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive

 

#### The Gaming Gen5 SSD for Laptops

It’s finally here! MARS 980 BLADE is a gaming Gen5 SSD built for laptops, featuring PCIe Gen5 x4 and NVMe 2.0 support. Its compact design ensures stable performance even in tight spaces, optimized for AI workloads and compatible with the latest Intel and AMD platforms. No matter where it's installed, it's built to go beyond the limits.

#### Clutch Moment. Legendary Move.

The MARS 980 BLADE features a sequential read/write speed of 14,000/13,000MB per second, which is double the performance of PCIe Gen4 SSDs and 8x faster than standard Gen3 SSDs. It is fully backward compatible with PCIe 4.0 and 3.0 platforms. Complete every challenge in mere seconds!

#### 6nm Control, Game Changer

Built with TSMC’s advanced 6nm process, the MARS 980 BLADE delivers superior performance-to-power efficiency, reducing heat generation in PCIe 5.0 SSDs and eliminating the need for bulky cooling—making it ideal for laptops and compact systems.

#### Expand PS5 Storage Capacity

The MARS 980 BLADE utilizes a PCIe 5.0 transmission interface and can be installed in the PS5 as an expansion hard drive to alleviate PS5 storage insufficiency issues. Not only does the MARS 980 BLADE fit perfectly into the PS5'a drive slot, it also provides a smooth and no-lag gaming experience while enjoying triple A masterpieces. 

*According to Sony, even if the read and write speed is higher than the official standard, not all games can actually experience the same performance as the PS5 console's built-in SSD.

#### Attention! Large Capacity Incoming!

Carefully selected 232-layer 3D NAND flash memory allows the MARS 980 BLADE to feature an ultra-large capacity of up to 8TB, and the SSD uses a variety of data protection and error correction technologies to greatly improve TBW (Total Bytes Written) and durability to meet high load requirements.

#### Beyond Elite

MARS 980 BLADE comes with SLC Caching and DRAM Cache Buffer for advantages in system loading and data caching. It features 4K random read/write of up to 2000K/1650K IOPS for smoother multitasking.

#### SSD Toolbox: Your SSD Problem-Solver

SSD Toolbox helps enhance overall performance and stability through the latest firmware updates, while also resolving occasional minor hardware and software issues. The Dashboard continuously monitors, analyzes, and reports S.M.A.R.T. data, allowing users to check SSD health and remaining lifespan, as well as current operating temperature and storage capacity—so you can stay on top of your SSD status at all times.

*To protect your SSD and valuable data, keep your firmware up to date. Click here to download SSD Toolbox for more details.

## MARS 980 PRO PCIe Gen5 x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive

### Fast Moves, Stay Cool

● PCIe Gen5 x4 transmission interface ● Up to 14,000/13,000MB/s sequential read/write speed ● Aluminum alloy and turbo fan form an active air-cooling system ● Compared with a fanless heatsink, temperatures significantly reduced by 15% ● Active cooling is powered directly from the M.2 slot, no additional charging cable needed ● 8TB capacity ● Supports latest Intel and AMD platforms ● 5-year warranty

#### Active Cooling, Maximum Heat Drop

An integrated turbo fan accelerates heat dissipation, while the unique active cooling system delivers up to 15% lower temperatures² compared to fanless designs.

With advanced air cooling, your system runs smoother than ever.

¹ The heatsink is pre-installed. Please ensure your system has sufficient space before installation. If your motherboard includes a pre-mounted M.2 heatsink, please remove it before installing this product. Refer to your motherboard manual for instructions.

² Cooling performance is based on internal lab test conditions. Actual results may vary depending on system configuration and environment.

³ Disassembling this product may void warranty and affect functionality.

Not only does the MARS 980 PRO fit perfectly into the PS5'a drive slot, it also provides a smooth and no-lag gaming experience while enjoying triple A masterpieces. 

*According to Sony, even if the read and write speed is higher than the official standard, not all games can actually experience the same performance as the PS5 console's built-in SSD.

#### Do More with Less Hassle

Cable management is annoying and complicated installations are such a headache! The MARS 980 PRO's built-in fan does not require an additional power cable and the SSD is ready to use as soon as it is plugged into the M.2 slot. Simplifying complexity is the best solution.

#### Attention! Large Capacity Incoming!

Carefully selected 232-layer 3D NAND flash memory allows the MARS 980 PRO to feature an ultra-large capacity of up to 8TB, and the SSD uses a variety of data protection and error correction technologies to greatly improve TBW (Total Bytes Written) and durability to meet high load requirements.

#### Beyond Elite

MARS 980 PRO comes with SLC Caching and DRAM Cache Buffer for advantages in system loading and data caching. It features 4K random read/write of up to 2000K/1650K IOPS for smoother multitasking.

# XPG Launches GAMMIX S70 PCIe Gen4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive

#### XPG Launches GAMMIX S70 PCIe Gen4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive

Taipei, Taiwan – September 21, 2020 – XPG, a provider of systems, components, and peripherals for gamers, esports pros, and tech enthusiasts, today announces the XPG GAMMIX S70 PCIe Gen4x4 M.2 2280 solid state drive (SSD). With the launch of the S70, XPG now offers a comprehensive lineup of Gen4 SSDs, which includes the GAMMIX S50 and S50 Lite, to meet a range of budgets and needs. With the adoption of next-gen PCIe 4.0, the GAMMIX S70 delivers unmatched read and write performance and has the distinction of being the world’s fastest M.2 SSD.

 With the advent of 5G networks and the ever-growing volume of data being processed, PCIe Gen4 is a critical upgrade that will bring storage devices to the next level. The GAMMIX S70 expands XPG’s Gen4 SSD series with a new option for discerning users seeking to harness the best that PCIe 4.0 can offer. Sporting blazing-fast read/write speeds of up to 7400/6400 MB per second. Users will have no doubt they have reached the pinnacle of SSD performance. In combination with NVMe 1.4 compatible, Dynamic SLC Caching, the S70 offers performance far superior to that of SATA and PCIe 3.0 SSDs. For added ease of use and convenience, the S70 is backward compatible with PCIe 3.0.

 For reliable operations and stability, the S70 is equipped with XPG’s proprietary CoolArmor heat spreader design. The aluminum heat spreader features a terraced structure, which resembles layers of armor, for increased surface area and hollow chambers underneath. This design provides for more effective heat dissipation that can reduce temperatures by up to thirty percent. 

 On top of its main performance parameters, the S70 supports LDPC error correcting code technology to detect and fix a more comprehensive range of data errors for more accurate data transmissions and a higher Total Bytes Written (TBW) rating. Also, with End-to-End (E2E) Data Protection and AES 256-bit Encryption, the S70 ensures data security and integrity. All of the components encased in the S70 have passed meticulous screening, testing, and certification to provide a reliability product of the highest quality. The S70 comes in 1TB and 2TB variants and is backed by a 5-year warranty.

 To find out about availability and prices in specific markets, please contact your nearest XPG representative via www.xpg.com. 

About XPG – XTREME PERFORMANCE GEAR XPG (XTREME PERFORMANCE GEAR) was established by ADATA to provide high-performance products to gamers, esports pros, and tech enthusiasts. We are committed to developing products that deliver extreme performance and therefore work closely with the gaming and esports community to gain insight into the real needs of users. We provide a full range of products from components, peripherals to devices, and create them with the highest standards of stability, reliability, and performance in mind. We also develop products with sheer cool designs that have earned us several prestigious international awards, such as iF Design and Good Design. Beyond products, we play an active role in sponsoring and supporting esports events and teams globally to realize extreme gaming experiences at the highest levels.
